# Media Puppies

> Performance marketing agency in Delhi NCR, India. Eight years, $10M+ in
> managed ad spend, 150+ clients, zero ad account bans. We run Meta and
> Google ads, SEO, influencer marketing and AI automation for D2C brands
> and lead-generation businesses, and report in cost per customer rather
> than impressions.

## What we do

- [Services](https://mediapuppies.com/services/): performance marketing, SEO, influencer marketing, AI automation, conversion systems, creative, tracking and attribution
- [SEO](https://mediapuppies.com/seo-services/): technical SEO, buying-intent content, local SEO and earned authority, reported in organic leads
- [Work](https://mediapuppies.com/work/): case studies — 4.2x ROAS for D2C skincare, ₹184 per lead for interior design, ₹312 per booked consult for an aesthetics clinic

## Who we work with

D2C and ecommerce, real estate, clinics and aesthetics, interior design,
education, and solar — businesses in India where one customer is worth
real money. Engagements are month-to-month with no lock-in. We audit
before we pitch, and we say no when paid media is not the right spend yet.
